craft_notes: Sthāyin: liṅga-pūjā unit 24. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 2. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: Gurus but in rite, in desired, from effort reject faults — thus they e
xplain Picu-spoken; not in obligatory rite — thus this.
l4.sanskrit_cite: guravastu vidhau kāmye yatnāddoṣāṃstyajediti vyācakṣate picuproktaṃ na nitye karmaṇītyadaḥ
